description: This file defines the BeanFactory class responsible for creating, caching, and managing SugarBean objects within the SuiteCRM system. It includes methods for retrieving beans by ID, reloading beans, managing cache, and loading bean class files.

classes.name: BeanFactory
classes.description: A factory class for creating and managing SugarBean objects, including caching and file loading mechanisms.

methods.name: getBean
methods.description: Retrieves a SugarBean object by module and ID, creating a new one if ID is not provided, with caching to prevent multiple retrievals.

methods.name: getReloadedBean
methods.description: Retrieves a fresh instance of a SugarBean by module and ID, bypassing cache.

methods.name: getShallowBean
methods.description: Creates a shallow bean used for relationship filling, not cached for reuse.

methods.name: convertParams
methods.description: Converts parameter input into an array format.

methods.name: initBeanRegistry
methods.description: Initializes internal registries for loaded beans and touched status.

methods.name: hasEncodeFlag
methods.description: Determines if encoding flag is set in parameters.

methods.name: hasDeletedFlag
methods.description: Determines if deleted flag is set in parameters.

methods.name: newBean
methods.description: Creates a new bean instance for a given module.

methods.name: getBeanMeta
methods.description: Returns metadata information about a bean module.

methods.name: getBeanName
methods.description: Retrieves core bean name for a module.

methods.name: getCustomBeanName
methods.description: Retrieves custom bean name for a module.

methods.name: getBeanClass
methods.description: Retrieves bean class name, preferring custom if available.

methods.name: getObjectName
methods.description: Retrieves core object name for a module.

methods.name: getCustomObjectName
methods.description: Retrieves custom object name for a module.

methods.name: getBeanFile
methods.description: Gets the file path for the core bean class.

methods.name: getCustomBeanFile
methods.description: Gets the file path for the custom bean class.

methods.name: loadBeanFile
methods.description: Loads the core and custom bean class files if they exist.

methods.name: registerBean
methods.description: Registers a bean instance in the cache, managing cache size and order.

methods.name: unregisterBean
methods.description: Removes a bean from cache by module and ID.
